summaries.text:
Law Enforcement Support and Counter Transnational Repression Act

This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to take actions to combat transnational repression against individuals inside the United States. The term transnational repression generally refers to actions of a foreign government or agent to harm, intimidate, threaten, harass, or coerce individuals in the United States.

Specifically, the bill requires DHS to direct the Office of Partnership and Engagement to conduct a public service announcement campaign to educate the public and international allies on the issue of transnational repression and related terrorism threats.

The bill also requires DHS to conduct research and development into technologies and techniques for enhancing its support to federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial officials in combating transnational repression and related terrorism threats.

title: Law Enforcement Support and Counter Transnational Repression Act
